requisitionDescription:
Title: Associate Designer, Women’s Hard Wovens

Salary Range: $80k-$90k


What You’ll Be Responsible For:

  • Research inspirational imagery in line with design direction and hand sketch styles and create presentation boards
  • Conceptualize and create compelling, brand right product for all Seasonal Deliveries
  • Engage in all aspects of design such as sketching, swatch and quality development, and fitting from Development through to Production 
  • Attend fittings and support Design Director with preparation and maintaining all fit changes 
  • Attend weekly Work In Progress (WIPs) meetings – accountable for maintaining records of all design changes 
  • Set up and maintain updated Bill of Materials (BOMs) to support design development, update BOMs through design process to support production readiness
  • Present CAD layout options including colorways to the team
  • Collaborate with head designer to own styles within each collection to design, develop and fit 
  • Maintain seasonal swatch library and inspiration closet
  • Supports and manages the trim development process, as directed by Director in partnership with Product Development
  • Communicates all design development changes to cross functional partners
  • Review development lab dips with R&D and Design Director before proceeding to sampling – must have strong sense of color and color theory knowledge
  • Coordinate and partner with PD on Design Pass-off to ensure all design details, trims, and colors are approved before handing over to Production teams to execute
  • Execute original design ideas and specific design development projects as assigned by the Design Director through sewing, draping, and mocking up, bringing key ideas to life
  • Works closely with Tech Design, Patternmakers and Sample Room to coordinate in-house design development 
  • Partner with PD on the status of styles in development daily to ensure product execution meets design specifications and are on track in style development process
  • Communicate with vendor and factories on design development
  • Work closely with manager and cross-functional teams to build brand right product that supports Vince’s financial and merchandising strategies 
  • Identify key seasonal trends and drive all corresponding development with oversees vendors 
  • Schedule and coordinate meetings with cross functional partners as needed
  • Engages with Tech Design and Production on fit intent and executes fit consistency
  • Shop the market to perform competitive analysis and translate market trends
  • Line sheet development
  • Follow up and coordinate all ongoing projects to meet stated deadlines
  • Performs additional duties and assignments, as requested

Qualifications/Experience We’re Looking For:
